definition: When an E.L.F. takes active control of an augment or system, overriding normal function — the digital equivalent of spirit possession in voodoo tradition. The user experiences their cyberware acting with apparent autonomy: a prosthetic arm moving without command, an optical implant showing things that aren't there, a neural interface feeding thoughts that aren't yours.
origin: Haitian Vodou terminology — 'being ridden by the loa' means a spirit has mounted you. Applied to E.L.F. encounters where the digital entity takes the driver's seat
example: His chrome hand reached out and caught the knife before he saw it. Riding the loa. Something in there wanted him alive.
